Author: pl1nk1
Name: Plain Fly Text
Punchline: Removes skill-name labels from floating combat text, with an optional speed slider.
Description: Removes the skill/ability name label from floating combat text, leaving only the number, color, size, and crit/direct-hit bounce animation. Also adds an optional speed slider (/plainflytext) that slows or speeds up native flytext's animation - lower makes numbers linger and float up more slowly.
